value.rationale: A natural endpoint unconditionality invariant is classified exactly for every arity b>=3 and every finite depth, not just estimated: it has a genuinely arity-dependent linear slope and a complete, strictly determined optimizing source-path sign pattern despite unrestricted off-path multipliers. The path rigidity and uniform-in-depth formula can serve as quantitative benchmarks for b-adic Haar and finite-filtration operator norms. Unlike the binary whole-scale case this permits every predictable sign pattern; the result is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a minor numerical increment.
